mentions.name: Lenzy
mentions.description: Product analytics platform for conversational AI that measures and improves the user experience of AI assistants embedded in SaaS products. It initially targeted vibe coding tools but now focuses on established SaaS companies adding AI assistants, replacing manual chat review with analytics.
mentions.problem: Companies adding AI assistants often lack insight into chat user experience; some have staff reading chats full time, while early AI tools with over 50% monthly churn focus on acquisition instead of retention.
mentions.audience: Established SaaS companies adding AI assistants to their existing products.
mentions.source_excerpt: Building https://lenzy.ai - 2 paid customers, 2 pilots, looking for more and figuring out positioning.

evidence.value: Building https://lenzy.ai - 2 paid customers, 2 pilots, looking for more and figuring out positioning.
evidence.author: BohdanPetryshyn

mentions.name: Lenzy
mentions.description: Analyzes users' chats from conversational AI products to help those companies reduce churn and prioritize product improvements.
mentions.problem: Conversational AI products face churn and lack insight into which product improvements to prioritize from their users' chats.
mentions.audience: Conversational AI product companies (e.g., Lovable or Cursor)
mentions.source_excerpt: Building https://lenzy.ai - helping conversational AI products (think Lovable or Cursor) reduce churn and prioritize product improvements by analyzing their user's chats.
